record.question: Which of the following clinical condition cannot be treated using aspirin?
options: Prevention of clot formation on atherosclerotic plaque
record.explanation: Answer C: Iron deficiency anaemia. Aspirin is used for fever, inflammation, and antiplatelet prevention in appropriate patients; it does not treat iron-deficiency anemia. Reference: https://www.nhlbi.nih.gov/health/anemia/iron-deficiency-anemia. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
